integrity: Exact all-length argument by inclusion-exclusion, finite character orthogonality and roots-of-unity counting; direct exact-integer checks are corroborative, not a replacement for proof.
scientific_limitations: Only additive ternary alphabets and onto words at lengths at least three. No explicit sharp even-length endpoint projection norm is proved. Historical novelty comparisons are bounded and an unindexed equivalent is possible.
title: A parity-resonant complete Fourier spectrum for ternary surjections
